essence: Breath, body, and the eightfold city are demoted to knowables: no ordering lies in breath, no restraint touches the self, and living-ness stands beyond non-showing (vv19-22).

Rest unfolds into freedom, doership, lordship; Māyā named from power alone; the beginningless mother-principle proclaimed; pervasion fenced to I-sharers; the world verdict that-nondual-made (vv23-27).

sections.SUMMARY: Breath joined with knowing still never proves: breath and kin are knowables, never knowers — else delusion. Locked in the living though things stand, curbed by breath and eightfold city, even there they abide in the supreme self. Breath proves no hold on that self-nature; recognition answers by living-ness past non-showing. No ordering sits in breath by I-blocking; shining's self-rest is sung as I-ness. Told already, that rest, all dependence blocked: freedom, doership foremost, lordship with it. Called Māyā, of his power alone, no other proven — world-maker lordship is non-showing-made. One alone through linking, proclaimed mother-principle of all awarenesses, self-feeling's synonym, beginningless. Pervasion and linking of the I-sharer fit nothing inert. So in difference shining's shining holds — recognition's word: this world that-nondual-made.
sections.FUNCTION: Closes by elimination then proclamation: breath demoted, confinement rehoused, restraint unproved, order relocated — then rest unfolded, Māyā named, the mother proclaimed, pervasion fenced, verdict spoken.
sections.KEY TERMS: prameya/pramātṛ (knowable/knower) · puryaṣṭaka (eightfold city) · akhyāti (non-showing) · ahaṃbhāva (I-ness) · viśrānti (rest) · svātantrya/kartṛtva/īśvaratā (freedom/doership/lordship) · māyā (Māyā) · mātṛtattva (mother-principle) · tadadvayamaya (that-nondual-made)
sections.LOCAL CONTEXT: Passage 3 of 3: vv. 19–27. Elimination complete, proclamation begins. Closes with iti śivam; Harabhaṭṭa colophon paratext.
sections.EXPLANATION: Breath fails despite knowings; locked order rehoused; restraint unprovable; ordering moved to I-ness. Rest opens into three offices; Māyā from power alone; one linking mother proclaimed; pervasion fenced; verdict keeps difference and non-difference, speaking the world nondual.
sections.BOUNDARY: sādhitā's scope held open as reading. śaiva ghost exorcised by feminine anaphora. v25 compound listed, not split. v27 double holding kept double. iti śivam and colophons excluded.
sections.RELATED: Īśvarapratyabhijñā appealed (v21/v27) · Spanda breath-doctrine demoted · Pratyabhijñāhṛdaya rest · v9 turn · Sambandhasiddhi third proof

rasa.sthayibhava: utsāha (exultation) as verdict-joy in proclaiming the close
rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is exultation: four verbs of proclaiming — sung (v22), told (v23), proclaimed (v25), said (v27) — carry the passage to its verdict. The vyabhicāri is wonder at rest unfolding into lordship. Abhinava's vīra as the relish of truth declared after dispute — homecoming spoken aloud.
